value=[7]

class C(metaclass=factory): pass
print(C is value)

saved=[]
def prepare(name,bases,**kw):
 ns={}
 saved.append((name,bases,ns,kw["tag"]))
 return ns
def factory(name,bases,ns,**kw):
 old=saved[0]
 print(name is old[0],bases is old[1],ns is old[2],kw["tag"] is old[3])
 return 7
factory.__prepare__=prepare
class C(metaclass=factory,**{"tag":[9]}): pass
class C(metaclass=7): print("body")
class C(metaclass=None): print("body")

class M(type): pass
class N(type): pass
class A(metaclass=M): pass
class B(metaclass=N): pass
def factory(name,bases,ns):
 print(bases==(A,B))
 return 7
class C(A,B,metaclass=factory): pass
print(C)

def factory(name,bases,ns): return 7
class C(metaclass=factory):
 def f(self): return __class__
print(C)

def factory(name,bases,ns): print("factory"); return 7
factory.__prepare__=lambda *args: print("never")
print(factory("C",(),{}))

def factory(name,bases,ns): return [ns["x"]]
def decorate(value):
 print(value[0])
 return value
@decorate
class C(metaclass=factory): x=7
print(C[0])
